title: Native-library allow-list
statement: The system shall link native C/C++ libraries into Rust server components only if each library is on an approved, version-pinned allow-list.
rationale: PO decision: FFI is permitted for proven dependencies (e.g. RocksDB for storage, aws-lc for FIPS-ready crypto), reviewed per dependency.

acceptance_criteria.text: A CI check (e.g. cargo-deny plus a build-script/linker audit) fails the build when a native library not on the allow-list, or at an unpinned version, is linked.
Each allow-list entry records owner, purpose, licence, pinned version and review date.
